Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.platform

Interface BucketOperations

public interface BucketOperations
Loader-specific fluid primitives used by the shared BBFluidLogic / SBFluidLogic orchestration and by shared bucket items directly. This interface is the whole loader surface of the fluid subsystem: a sided block-storage probe and one-unit move, vanilla water/lava cauldron transitions, arbitrary-fluid world placement, per-fluid fill/empty sounds, native powder-snow placement finalization, fluid presentation, the aquatic Mob Bucket water pair, held-container transfer, and the Forge FillBucketEvent carve-out.

World-operation methods are called on both logical sides. Unless stated otherwise, a true result means an accepted client prediction or a completed server operation; false means the operation was rejected without changing bucket or world state. The server is authoritative. Keep signatures in vanilla and StoredFluid terms; convert loader-native fluid values at the loader boundary.

    • cauldronTake

      boolean cauldronTake(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, BucketOperations.CauldronFluid fluid, ProtectionContext context)
      Drains one bucket-volume of fluid from a full cauldron at pos into the bucket, emptying the cauldron. Checks ProtectionAction.BLOCK_INTERACT, plays the fill sound, and on server success credits a finite bucket while leaving a Source Bucket unchanged. Loaders that expose vanilla cauldrons as sided fluid storage return false here and rely on blockTake(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext, boolean).
      Returns:
      true when the transition happened

    • cauldronPlace

      boolean cauldronPlace(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, BucketOperations.CauldronFluid fluid, ProtectionContext context)
      Fills an empty cauldron at pos to a full fluid cauldron from the bucket. Checks ProtectionAction.BLOCK_INTERACT, plays the empty sound, and on server success debits a finite bucket while leaving a Source Bucket unchanged. Loaders that expose vanilla cauldrons as sided fluid storage leave empty cauldrons to blockPlace(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext, boolean). A Source Bucket at an already full cauldron of fluid reports success without changing either side.
      Returns:
      true when the transition happened

    • placeArbitraryFluid

      boolean placeArbitraryFluid(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, ProtectionContext context, StoredFluid stored, boolean asSource, boolean allowFaceOffset)
      Places one bucket-volume of stored into the world honoring the loader's vaporization, block-state, and empty-sound rules. Checks ProtectionAction.FLUID_EDIT (and ProtectionAction.BLOCK_EDIT when a replaceable block would be destroyed), emits the fluid-place game event, and on server success debits a finite bucket while leaving a Source Bucket unchanged.
      Parameters:
      asSource - whether the acting bucket is a Source Bucket
      allowFaceOffset - whether an unusable clicked position may resolve to the neighbor
      Returns:
      true for an accepted client prediction or a completed server placement

    • placeStoredPowder

      boolean placeStoredPowder(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, ProtectionContext context, boolean allowFaceOffset)
      Places one stored powder-snow block. The loader builds the BlockPlaceContext (whose constructor is not accessible to common), honors allowFaceOffset, checks ProtectionAction.BLOCK_EDIT at the resolved position, runs BlockItem.place(net.minecraft.world.item.context.BlockPlaceContext) on Items.POWDER_SNOW_BUCKET with its own block-place-event and rollback behavior, and on server success debits one unit. The caller has already guarded powder-snow mode.
      Parameters:
      allowFaceOffset - whether an unusable clicked position may resolve to the neighbor
      Returns:
      true for an accepted client prediction or a committed server placement
